summary: Electra Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting the closing of its initial public offering of 23,333,334 shares of common stock at $15.00 per share, yielding approximately $350.0 million in gross proceeds before underwriting discounts and expenses. The filing also documents the adoption of an amended and restated certificate of incorporation and bylaws effective upon the IPO close, following prior board and stockholder approval. No special-situation transaction, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is implicated; this is a routine post-IPO current report.
